description: This PHP class defines a Symfony Console command 'add-role-permission' that facilitates adding permissions for user roles to data groups within the OrangeHRM system. It includes configuration, interaction, execution logic, and utility methods for managing role-permission associations.

classes.name: AddRolePermissionCommand
classes.description: Symfony console command class for adding role permissions to data groups.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command description, arguments, and options.

methods.name: interact
methods.description: Interactively prompts for data group name, user role, and permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Creates an autocomplete question for selecting data group.

methods.name: getUserRoleAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Creates an autocomplete question for selecting user role.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main logic to process inputs, create permissions, and optionally persist data.

methods.name: printDataGroupPermissionTable
methods.description: Displays current permissions for a data group in table format.

methods.name: printDataGroupPermissionSQL
methods.description: Outputs sample SQL queries for permission insertion.

methods.name: printBlock
methods.description: Outputs a formatted block of SQL query text.
